turns.content: Rough morning on the eval edge. The staging gateway restarted twice overnight and the collector heartbeat panel went blank both times. Can you check whether that was the watchdog acting up or something new we should worry about?
Both restarts were the watchdog reacting to a wedged config reload, not a new failure. I pinned the reload lock fix onto the eval edge and the heartbeat panel has been solid since the second restart.

Thanks. The synthetic producer we run against staging is still publishing under the old namespace from before the reorg, so the dashboards double-count its stream. Can you move it over so the graphs stop lying?
Moved the synthetic producer to the new namespace and rebuilt its dashboard queries; the double-counted series flatlined immediately and the remaining lines now match real eval traffic one to one.

The eval tenants file also still lists the two teams that left the pilot last quarter. Their dead budgets keep skewing the admission graphs. Can you prune them and archive whatever bookkeeping goes with them?
Pruned both departed teams from the eval tenants file and archived their budget rows next to the pilot notes; the admission graphs now track only tenants that are actually sending.
Last one: the staging spool disk keeps flirting with the usage alarm every soak night. Can you grow the volume before the next soak fills it and pages whoever is on call for no good reason?
Grew the staging spool volume and re-ran the soak projection; the next run fits with comfortable headroom and the usage alarm threshold is no longer within reach of a normal soak.
